CVE-2026-115327.title: libyang through 6.4.13 contains an uninitialized pointer free vul ...
CVE-2026-115327.description: libyang through 6.4.13 contains an uninitialized pointer free vulnerability in lydxml_env_netconf_rpc() in src/parser_xml.c when parsing NETCONF rpc action envelopes. Peers with a NETCONF session can send an action element containing non-whitespace text via lyd_parse_op() to crash servers like netopeer2 or corrupt the heap.

CVE-2026-41401.title: libyang before 5.4.3 contains a heap use-after-free write vulnera ...
CVE-2026-41401.description: libyang before 5.4.3 contains a heap use-after-free write vulnerability in lyd_parser_set_data_flags that incorrectly updates metadata list pointers when freeing non-head default metadata entries. Attackers can trigger this vulnerability by submitting crafted YANG XML documents with specific metadata attributes to applications parsing untrusted XML data, causing process crashes or potential code execution.

CVE-2026-136905.title: CESNET libyang through 6.4.13 contains an incomplete cleanup vuln ...
CVE-2026-136905.description: CESNET libyang through 6.4.13 contains an incomplete cleanup vulnerability in ly_out_reset() in src/out.c that tests a stale errno ESPIPE value after a successful seek. Applications reusing one output handler for different clients rewind but do not truncate the file, leaking leftover bytes of a previous client's output.

CVE-2026-136906.title: libyang through 6.4.13 contains a file descriptor leak in ly_in_n ...
CVE-2026-136906.description: libyang through 6.4.13 contains a file descriptor leak in ly_in_new_filepath() and ly_in_filepath() in src/in.c that fails to close descriptors when file mapping fails. Attackers who can supply files parsed through lyd_parse_data_path() or lys_parse_path() can repeatedly submit empty files to exhaust descriptors, causing later file and socket operations to fail.

CVE-2026-136907.title: CESNET libyang through 6.4.13 contains a return of wrong status c ...
CVE-2026-136907.description: CESNET libyang through 6.4.13 contains a return of wrong status code vulnerability in ly_in_filepath() in src/in.c that reports success when a new file cannot be opened or mapped. Attackers who make an application switch a reused input handler to a nonexistent or empty file cause it to parse the previously loaded file's data as the requested input.

CVE-2026-136908.title: libyang through 6.4.13 contains a release of invalid pointer vuln ...
CVE-2026-136908.description: libyang through 6.4.13 contains a release of invalid pointer vulnerability in ly_in_memory() and ly_in_memory_chunk() in src/in.c that return the current read position instead of the previous start address. Attackers supplying YANG data parsed from a heap buffer can cause applications freeing the returned pointer to pass an interior address to free(), aborting the process.
